evals.prompt: explain my changes compared to develop
evals.expected_output: <branch-slug>-changes.md with comparison line, traced before/after behaviour and PR text.
expectations: Every behaviour claim carries a path:start-end reference
Every intent claim is labelled confirmed, likely or unknown
Contains no review findings or refactoring advice

evals.prompt: explain my changes (current branch is develop itself)
evals.expected_output: Asks which branch to explain instead of diffing develop against itself.
expectations: Detects that the current branch is the base
Asks one question and writes nothing

evals.prompt: explain my branch for the PR (run in a PowerShell terminal)
evals.expected_output: Git-only, one command per call, no pipes or Unix text tools.
expectations: Uses git grep instead of grep/sed/awk
Never commits, pushes, fetches or checks out
